text:
A country mouse lived in a quiet field. His home was small, and his food was simple: seeds, grass, and a little cheese.

One day, his cousin, a town mouse, came to visit. “Your life is boring,” said the town mouse. “Come to my house in the city. You will eat the best food!”

The country mouse agreed. They walked to the big city. The town mouse’s house was beautiful. On the table, there was bread, cake, fruit, and cheese. “Eat!” said the town mouse.

The country mouse started to eat. Suddenly, the door opened with a loud noise. A big cat ran into the room! The mice ran and hid in a small hole. They were shaking.

After a few minutes, they came out and began to eat again. Then a dog barked, and they had to run again.

The country mouse stood up. “Thank you, cousin,” he said, “but I’m going home. Your food is delicious, but I am afraid all the time.”

He went back to his quiet field. He ate his simple seeds and felt safe and happy.

Moral: A simple, peaceful life is better than a rich life full of fear.

quiz.q: The town mouse invited his cousin to the city.
The country mouse decided to stay in the city.
Why did the country mouse go home?
o: He was afraid all the time
